title: Turkish Object Relative Clauses (-dik)
summary: Forming object-focus relative clauses (e.g., 'the book that I read').
explanation: Attach '-dik/-dük' plus possessive markers to verb stems to create relative clauses where the modified noun is the object.

example_translations.ex_trdik_1: The book I read yesterday was very nice.

common_error_explanations.err_trdik_1: Use object participle suffix '-dik' combined with possessives for relative clauses.
